4042.desc: A bouquet of golden sunflowers with white jasmine, juxtaposing the splendor of the summer sun with the tranquility of the summer night.

5001.name: Shellfish
5001.desc: Shellfish shells are often used as a material in ornaments and handicrafts.

5002.name: Catfish
5002.desc: A plump catfish. It's suited for dishes with heavy seasoning.

5003.name: Koi Carp
5003.desc: A representative of the taste of freshwater seafood. It's featured as the chef's special in some restaurants.

5004.name: Common Carp
5004.desc: A type of edible fish. Its flesh is smooth and highly nutritious.

5005.name: Freshwater Shrimp
5005.desc: An example of quality seafood that is high in protein, low in fat, and low in calories.

5006.name: Crayfish
5006.desc: A crayfish commonly found in rivers and similar bodies of water. It has a very rustic texture.

5007.name: Sea Bass
5007.desc: A fresh sea bass. Its white and tender flesh is perfect for steamed and sauted dishes.

5008.name: Crab
5008.desc: A fresh and tasty crab. Its somewhat sweet flesh is full of nutrients and flavor.

5101.name: Squid
5101.desc: A chewy squid. Tastes good both grilled and roasted.

5102.name: Mackerel
5102.desc: A speedy fish with an aerodynamic body. Its flesh is firm and perfect for pan-frying with aromatics.

5103.name: Tuna
5103.desc: Tuna that's high in protein, low in fat. It's one of the top targets of fishermen.

5104.name: Salmon
5104.desc: A popular fish used in seafood. Its flesh with its beautiful patterns and abundant umami flavor are its standout features.

5105.name: Red Sea Bream
5105.desc: An omnivorous fish. They like to swim in groups and move quickly. They're also widely adored for being high in nutrients.

5106.name: Black Porgy
5106.desc: It's a quick and crafty little creature. It takes considerable skill to catch.

5107.name: Yellowfin Tuna
5107.desc: Fine-quality yellowfin tuna. It's low in fat and often ends up inside cans.

5108.name: Sea Cucumber
5108.desc: A nourishing sea cucumber. It requires a bit of patience and luck to get your hands on.

9900.name: Pearl
9900.desc: Natural jewelry with a warm color. It has a flourishing market of sellers and buyers.

110001.name: Sea Salt Drink
110001.desc: Recovers 50 stamina. A basic energy drink. This drink feels like a salty breeze rolling over the tip of your tongue. It's salty, sweet, and unique.

110002.name: Green Verdure Drink
110002.desc: Recovers 50 stamina. Character also gains a buff: all stats increase by 3% for 8 hours. This drink's verdant, fresh aroma clears your head.

110003.name: Strawberry Drink
110003.desc: Recovers 50 stamina and grants a buff: for 8 hours, when producing basic resources, increases working speed by 5%. Its sweet strawberry fragrance fills you with joy and energy.

110004.name: Kumquat Drink
110004.desc: Recovers 50 stamina and grants a buff: for 8 hours, when manufacturing items at the Base Factory, increases working speed by 5%. While the kumquat is a bit sour, its aftertaste is sweet and uplifting.

110005.name: Berry Drink
110005.desc: Recovers 50 stamina and grants a buff: for 8 hours, when cooking food, working speed increases by 5%. Sweet and sour, it's brimming with the joyful and fruity flavor of berries.

110006.name: Grape Drink
110006.desc: Recovers 50 stamina. Character also gains a buff: when assigned to manage a food store, food sales are increased by 5% for 8 hours. Its smooth and sweet flavor is impossible to get enough of.
